meta.title: Antenna Rotator Control
meta.description: Controls Hamlib-compatible azimuth antenna rotators from the RadioControl toolbar.
meta.readmeMarkdown:
# Antenna Rotator Control

Global TX-5DR utility plugin for Hamlib-compatible azimuth antenna rotators.

## Features

- Adds a `radio-control-toolbar` iframe button to RadioControl.
- Uses FontAwesome `arrows-rotate` and a large popover UI.
- Talks to `hamlib@0.7.1` through a runtime `import('hamlib')`, expecting the host TX-5DR server to provide the dependency.
- Supports serial/USB and network `rotctld` style endpoints.
- Provides setup, connection testing, real position polling, manual target input, presets, STOP, park fallback, and diagnostics.

## Safety Defaults

- Azimuth-only v1; elevation is not controlled.
- First movement in a browser session requires confirmation.
- Large jumps, stale feedback, park, and reset require explicit confirmation.
- Commands are serialized, soft limits are enforced server-side, and movement timeout triggers a stop attempt.

## Build

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm test
```

The plugin declares `hamlib@0.7.1` as an optional peer dependency and ships a local type shim for that API surface. Runtime still uses the host-provided Hamlib capability; the marketplace artifact must include `dist/index.js`, `dist/rotator-utils.js`, `src/locales`, and `dist/ui`, but never `node_modules/hamlib`.

en.pluginDescription: Controls Hamlib-compatible azimuth antenna rotators from the RadioControl toolbar.
en.setupHintDescription: Configure the rotator inside the RadioControl toolbar popup. The plugin uses the host hamlib dependency at runtime and stores rotator profiles in plugin global storage.
en.advancedConfigHint: One key=value per line, applied with setConf() before open().
en.presetsHint: Presets appear on the control tab for quick moves to common azimuths.
en.noElevation: Azimuth-only v1: elevation is never commanded and is sent as 0 when required by Hamlib.
en.firstMoveConfirm: The antenna is about to move. Confirm that the rotation area is clear of people, obstacles, and cable strain.
en.largeStepConfirm: Large movement detected. Confirm before sending this command.
en.parkConfirm: Park may move the antenna. Continue?
en.resetConfirm: Reset is a controller-level command. Continue only if you are sure.
en.staleConfirm: Hardware feedback is stale or unknown. Continue using the target angle anyway?
en.outOfLimit: Target is outside configured soft limits.
en.notConnected: Connect a rotator before sending movement commands.
en.hostHamlibMissing: Host hamlib dependency is not available. Make sure TX-5DR server includes hamlib@0.7.1.
en.hardware_position_outside_soft_limits: Hardware position is outside soft limits
en.networkBackend: Network mode always uses Hamlib / NET rotctl (#2) to connect to a remote rotctld endpoint, so no hardware model is selected here. Configure the hardware model on the rotctld side.

zh.pluginDescription: 从 RadioControl 工具栏控制兼容 Hamlib 的方位角天线旋转器。
zh.setupHintDescription: 请在 RadioControl 工具栏弹出窗口中配置旋转器。插件运行时使用宿主的 hamlib 依赖，并把旋转器配置保存在插件全局存储中。
zh.advancedConfigHint: 每行一个 key=value，会在 open() 前通过 setConf() 应用。
zh.presetsHint: 预设会显示在控制页，可快速转到常用方位角。
zh.noElevation: v1 仅控制方位角：不会控制仰角；Hamlib 需要时固定传 0。
zh.firstMoveConfirm: 即将转动天线，请确认旋转范围内没有人员、障碍物或线缆拉扯风险。
zh.largeStepConfirm: 检测到大角度转动，请确认后再发送命令。
zh.parkConfirm: 归位可能会移动天线。是否继续？
zh.resetConfirm: 重置是控制器级命令。请确认硬件状态安全后继续。
zh.staleConfirm: 硬件角度反馈未知或已过期。是否仍按目标角度发送命令？
zh.outOfLimit: 目标角度超出已配置软限位。
zh.notConnected: 请先连接旋转器，再发送转动命令。
zh.hostHamlibMissing: 宿主 hamlib 依赖不可用。请确认 TX-5DR 服务端包含 hamlib@0.7.1。
zh.emptyRotators: Hamlib 未返回可用旋转器型号。
zh.park_fallback_set_home: 归位兜底：转到归位角度
zh.hardware_position_outside_soft_limits: 硬件真实角度超出软限位
zh.networkBackend: 网络模式固定使用 Hamlib / NET rotctl (#2) 连接远端 rotctld，因此无需再选择具体硬件型号。硬件型号在 rotctld 侧配置。
